objective: Instantiate TOOL_DISCOVERY_COMPLETE_INTERFACE_CONTRACT_V1 on a real changing zero-cost ecosystem using the complete enabled public APT package-index epoch of an independent Ubuntu runner.

instance_design.source_enumeration: apt-get indextargets over every enabled Packages index
instance_design.discovery_result: every Package/Version/Architecture stanza in the queried source index
instance_design.completeness_crosscheck: union of source Package names must equal apt-cache dumpavail package-name universe

metadata.availability: identity is present in epoch Packages index
metadata.authorization: source is public HTTP(S) without embedded credentials
metadata.cost: 0 USD for metadata discovery/public package acquisition

instance_design.safe_probe: download coreutils from the same APT epoch, extract it without installation, execute sha256sum --version, bind receipt to epoch root
instance_design.epoch: SHA256 of all enabled APT source-config hashes plus all Packages-index source identities and content hashes
instance_design.change_rule: if epoch root changes, restart selection episode and discard prior epoch probe authority
